# netbox_vlan_translation_rule (Data Source)

The VLAN translation rule model has no unique `name` field, unlike most other NetBox objects. A rule is therefore looked up either by its `id`, or by the combination of `policy_id` and `local_vid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get VLAN translation rule by id
data "netbox_vlan_translation_rule" "test_by_id" {
  id = "1"
}

// Get VLAN translation rule by policy and local VLAN ID
data "netbox_vlan_translation_rule" "test" {
  policy_id = netbox_vlan_translation_policy.test.id
  local_vid = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `policy_id` must be given.
- `local_vid` (Number) Used together with `policy_id` to narrow down the result when not looking up by `id`.
- `policy_id` (Number) At least one of `id` or `policy_id` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `remote_vid` (Number)
